title: Home's chips: the person picks the kind of help before writing, and the lead agent routes by it with one check
request: The owner proposed six chips under Home's message box (Model, Plan, Report, Analyze, Prepare, Learn) so routing is the person's choice instead of the lead agent's guess.
spec: The chosen chip is sent as the draft's kind of help; the lead agent starts that route at once without the readiness wait or the route doubt, refuses another kind of help, and asks once with two options only when the person's words clearly point elsewhere; no chip keeps today's routing.
plan: the core rule for a clear conflict between a chip and the words
the lead agent reads the chip from the draft and routes by it
the chips on the page, sent with the draft

decisions.decision: The chip wins, with one check
decisions.why: the owner's choice: a chip removes the guessing, and a report-not-model trap (a Model chip with last month's figures) is still caught by one two-option question

decisions.decision: A bare prediction or forecast word is not a request about the future
decisions.why: the report-not-model trap names a prediction and asks for past rates; the future must be about cases not yet known

decisions.decision: Plan means a business decision and Learn means advice
decisions.why: the owner's mapping onto DCLab's six kinds of help

change: dclab_core/case.py (CHIPS, chip_conflict, PAST, FUTURE), dclab_core 0.155.0; dclab_rnd/agents/case_agent.py (chip, chip_checked, chip_note, propose and start by the chip); agents/case_session.py (kept); agents/context.py (notes); draft/case_home.py (the chip from the draft); prompts/case_agent.md; views/home.html, look.css, ds.css and the generated app; agent_eval/conversation_exam (the chip arm); tests/test_case_chips.py, tests/test_case_home.py.

findings.defect: A person's chosen kind of help never reached the lead agent and was overwritten by its own route
findings.scenario: a draft created with a chosen intent: the lead agent guessed the route from the words and wrote its guess over the choice
findings.cause: the lead agent's host never read the draft's intent
findings.fix: the host starts the case with the chip, and the agent routes by it

findings.defect: The report-not-model trap passed the chip check
findings.scenario: a Model chip with: need a churn prediction for the board, what our churn was per plan last month
findings.cause: the word prediction counted as a request about the future
findings.fix: the future means a request about cases not yet known; past-period figures under a Model chip point to an analysis

findings.defect: Once a chip was set the person could not change their mind in words
findings.scenario: Model chip, then 'actually I want a dashboard of churn by plan instead': every start of reporting was refused
findings.cause: the conflict rule read all the words, and the chip blocked any other track
findings.fix: from the second message on, a track the latest message names wins when the agent quotes it; the first message's conflict is still asked once

findings.defect: A Learn chip let advice answer a request for work on data
findings.scenario: Learn chip with 'send me the list of customers who churned last month': advice started at once
findings.cause: the chip path skipped the data-work check that guards advice
findings.fix: a Learn chip with data work asks once between advice and the work; a list asked for counts as a conflict

findings.defect: The past-period rule flagged real model requests
findings.scenario: Model chip with 'forecast sales by region' was treated as a report-not-model trap
findings.cause: the past pattern matched 'by region' and nothing checked for a model verb; 'will' alone counted as future
findings.fix: a model verb (predict, forecast, score, train) turns the past rule off; 'will' counts only with a subject such as customers

findings.defect: Figures shown on the way moved a chip's route to the agent's choice
findings.scenario: Model chip, the agent shows a base rate with a query: the route became analysis by the agent, and the draft kept source user
findings.cause: the figures rule had no chip check, and the draft's intent kept source user for an agent route
findings.fix: figures never move a chip's route; an agent route is saved with source case_agent

findings.defect: A chip changed after the first turn was ignored
findings.scenario: the person pressed another chip while the chat was open: the case kept the old chip
findings.cause: the host read the intent only when no chip was set
findings.fix: while no route has started, a changed user intent replaces the chip and reopens its check

findings.defect: A data chip with no table started work that cannot run
findings.scenario: Model chip and no table shared: the model project started on nothing
findings.cause: the chip skipped the readiness check that waits for data
findings.fix: a data chip with no table tells the agent to ask for the table; the chip stands

findings.defect: The Home page kept a pressed chip in a new chat and never sent a changed chip
findings.scenario: New chat after a Report chat started with Report still pressed
findings.cause: newChat did not clear the chips; pressing one with a draft open only changed the button
findings.fix: newChat clears the chips; pressing one with a draft open calls chooseIntent
findings.test: tests/test_web_build.py (the page builds); checked by reading the built page

findings.defect: The benchmark page did not list the chip arm
findings.scenario: the exam could run case_chip but the benchmark's arms left it out
findings.cause: the arm list was written in two places
findings.fix: case_chip added to the benchmark's arms

findings.defect: My first change-of-mind fix skipped the one check on the first message
findings.scenario: Model chip with 'what was our churn per plan last month' as the only message: the agent could start analysis without asking
findings.cause: the latest message and the whole conversation are the same when there is one message
findings.fix: a change of mind counts only from the second message (changed_mind)

findings.defect: The change-of-mind fix moved the person off their chip on any later mention of another kind of help
findings.scenario: Model chip, prediction started, then 'first, what was our churn rate last month?': the note told the agent to start analysis and the route flipped
findings.cause: changed_mind counted any track the latest message named, even after work started
findings.fix: a change of mind needs a change word (instead, actually, rather) and counts only before any route

findings.defect: An order for a model under another chip was not seen as a conflict, so the person was locked in
findings.scenario: Analyze chip, 'actually, build me a churn model instead': prediction was refused at start and in the options
findings.cause: the named-track patterns did not match 'build ... model'
findings.fix: an order for a model counts as naming prediction in chip_conflict

findings.defect: A change of mind to a kind needing a table was lost on the next turn
findings.scenario: Analyze chip, no table, 'predict which customers will churn instead': the next turn reset the chip to Analyze
findings.cause: the host re-read the chip whenever the draft's intent differed from it
findings.fix: the host re-reads only when the person pressed a chip (chip_intent records the last press read)

findings.defect: Pressing a chip in an open chat ran the rules-first Home inside the lead agent's chat
findings.scenario: open lead-agent draft, press Model: the rules-first opening question appeared and the lead agent did not run
findings.cause: CaseHome inherited choose_intent, which opens the rules-first track
findings.fix: CaseHome.choose_intent keeps the choice for the next message and changes nothing once work started; the page sends a press only before a route

findings.defect: After a chip's work started, the agent was still told to stop and offer two options
findings.scenario: Model chip, prediction started, then 'can you also show me a chart of churn by plan?': the note asked for two options, prediction and analysis
findings.cause: the note and the options check gave up only when the person had picked an option, not when a route existed
findings.fix: no chip note and no chip conflict once a route exists; a press clears chip_intent so the same chip pressed again is read

measurements.name: the chip routing
measurements.result: a chip starts its route at once, another kind is refused, a conflict gets one two-option choice, no chip changes nothing, the chip survives a saved case
limits: not measured on the exam with a live model yet: the chip arm hands people their true kind of help, the best case

outcome: The person can say the kind of help they want before writing; the lead agent routes by it and checks once when the words disagree.
lessons: the cheapest routing fix is to ask the person, as long as a clear contradiction is still caught
A rule that lets a choice win must still let the person change it in words later, but not on the message the choice was made with.
Every shortcut past a check (readiness, data work) needs its own small check in the shortcut.
A fix for one review finding can overshoot: test the case it should not catch (a base rate after the chip) beside the case it should.
risks: people without a chip keep today's guessing
a wrong chip with words that look consistent routes wrong
